tldr: Pluto through the 6th house intensifies work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When Pluto moves through your 6th house, it brings pressure to work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

Something may no longer stay buried, controlled, avoided, or handled only on the surface. It can help you face the deeper truth and stop spending energy protecting a false version of peace.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for trying to control the outcome so tightly that you cannot tell what is changing naturally. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

Pluto moves through this house for a long chapter. Work with the deeper truth instead of forcing everything back into the old shape.
